about.title: About Construction Concepts & Design
text: Construction Concepts is an award-winning commercial construction firm specializing in high precision craftmanship and advanced building techniques to create one-of-a-kind spaces across multiple industries. Working hand-in-hand with designers and architects, we deliver visual unity to the design and build process.
For over two decades, we have mastered the ability to bring complex designs to life with a thorough understanding of the process from concept to completion.

As a full-service commercial design + build contractor, we offer a custom design + build process that streamlines the often-fragmented design, engineering, and construction phases enabling you to save valuable time and money by having one point of contact throughout your project. Our one-on-one approach ensures that we understand your needs from the start and enables us to mitigate issues before they arise and advise you on each step of the process.
